name: Wish Farms
description: US grower-marketer with an in-house breeding effort led by Carlos Fear, a plant breeder with 35 years of industry experience (much of it at Driscoll's, where he helped develop industry-leading berry varieties) and inventor or co-inventor on 35 patents spanning raspberries, blackberries and strawberries. Perishable News reports the company accelerating its own raspberry and blackberry breeding.

attributes.lead_breeder_background: 35 years in industry, largely at Driscoll's; inventor/co-inventor on 35 patents across raspberry, blackberry and strawberry
